text: {"assertions":["A blank render bug in ui/components/DataTable.tsx was fixed on 2026-02-20","The blank render issue occurred when two requests raced on the same key","The bug could be reproduced by opening the table with a saved column layout","The root cause was an off-by-one error in a slice bound","The bug manifested as an empty tbody element with no console error","A previously flaky test improved from 90 failures per hundred runs to zero failures after the fix","The fix was submitted in PR #2637 on branch fix/blank-render-1 and included adding a property test","This blank render bug was in the same area of DataTable.tsx as earlier blank render work"]}
